title: 선물 포장 부탁: 따로 포장해 주세요
objective: You can ask for gift wrapping and say why you bought something with -(으)려고.
summary: A customer asks a shop to gift-wrap items and says why using -(으)려고.
setting: The checkout counter of a small gift shop. A customer asks the clerk to wrap two mugs as gifts.

task.title: Ask for gift wrapping
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to combine sentences, choose words, and answer in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: The wrapping paper is really pretty.
This piece of clothing has no price tag.

words.meaning: to take off, to remove (a tag or sticker)
words.exampleMeaning: I took off the price tag and wrapped it.

words.meaning: in order to. Vowel or ㄹ stem + 려고 (가려고, 만들려고); other consonant stem + 으려고 (먹으려고).
words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to Myeongdong to meet a friend.

dialogue.meaning: Welcome. Shall I ring these up for you?

dialogue.korean: 네. 이거 선물하려고 샀어요. 선물 포장 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes. I bought these to give as gifts. Can you gift-wrap them?

dialogue.korean: 네, 돼요. 두 개 같이 포장해 드릴까요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, we can. Shall I wrap the two together?

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 따로 해 주세요. 두 사람한테 주려고 두 개 샀어요.
dialogue.meaning: No, please wrap them separately. I bought two to give to two people.

dialogue.korean: 포장지는 빨간색하고 파란색이 있어요. 뭐로 해 드릴까요?
dialogue.meaning: We have red and blue wrapping paper. Which one would you like?

dialogue.korean: 파란색으로 해 주세요. 리본도 달아 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Blue, please. Please put a ribbon on them too.

exercises: Combine the two parts with -(으)려고: ① 선생님한테 주다 / 꽃을 샀어요 ② 케이크를 만들다 / 우유를 샀어요 ③ 사진을 찍다 / 카메라를 가져왔어요
You bought two gifts for two different people. Choose the right word: 두 개 (같이 / 따로) 포장해 주세요.
Choose the right word for each blank: ① 선물이에요. ____를 떼 주세요. (가격표 / 리본) ② 파란색 ____로 포장해 주세요. (포장지 / 가격표) ③ 리본이 없어요. 리본도 ____ 주세요. (달아 / 떼)
The clerk asks: 왜 두 개 샀어요? You bought two mugs to give to two people. Answer in Korean with -(으)려고: ____
answers: ① 선생님한테 주려고 꽃을 샀어요. ② 케이크를 만들려고 우유를 샀어요. ③ 사진을 찍으려고 카메라를 가져왔어요.
① 가격표 ② 포장지 ③ 달아
